encoding: Payload+epoch+sequence together, 32-bit words protected by 39-bit SECDED. All real FF-bank stored bits protected; no raw payload array.
ABI: Same explicit wepoch/repoch caller obligation and core4:VM3 ports as SRAM backend.
physical_area: Requires actual ASIC synthesis; logical FF count never treated as routed area.
epoch_binding: Real clock edge; peer epoch complementary pairs reset invalid (0/0). Corrupt local epoch rails take priority over caller epoch changes and fail closed.
consumer_landing: Eight actual coded-word R-clock FF banks, direct source-slot to consumer landing crossings; 8:1 selection occurs only after consumer clock capture. Publication synchronizers provide settling before selection; consumer decoder/epoch/sequence and held-output seal still guard every observed word.
